name: manual_22093a
claim: A stale GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable silently overrides a valid gh/git keyring credential over HTTPS, producing '401 Bad credentials' or 'Invalid username or token' even when 'gh auth status' shows a correctly logged-in account. Fix: unset GITHUB_TOKEN before git push / gh api calls, and re-unset every time since shell env does not persist across tool-call boundaries in this harness.

decisions.notes: Hit this exact failure pushing to diazMelgarejo/Claude-Desktop-LLM: 'gh auth status' showed a valid keyring login for the right account, but git push still failed until GITHUB_TOKEN was unset and gh auth switch was re-run against the keyring account.
